page: OVHcloud c3-320 is a compute-optimized server powered by AMD EPYC processors using the x86_64 architecture. It features 160 dedicated physical cores with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 320 GB of RAM, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 20 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core CPU testing and PassMark CPU scores placing in the top 10%. The server also demonstrates top-tier memory bandwidth for small cached blocks and strong performance for large uncached blocks. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, and ray tracing workloads all register in the top 10% of benchmarks. Single-core performance is strong, though single-threaded compression tasks fall into the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c3-320 offers high compute density with dedicated physical cores, making it highly effective for parallel processing tasks without hyperthreading overhead. The inclusion of a local NVMe SSD and 20 Gbps network bandwidth supports data-intensive operations. This server is suited for highly parallelized workloads, including software compilation, multi-threaded decompression, ray tracing, high-throughput Redis database operations, and static web serving.
